previous_release.label: Platform Convergence
previous_release.completion_note: Source, D1 baseline, canonical gates and exact Development Pages deployment completed. Authenticated runtime, Stripe test, PayPal sandbox and CAIP private-media evidence moved to the deferred I.T. test environment and do not gate forward releases.

development_infrastructure.account_selection: local tooling pins CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; Pages Git deployment owns its account context

database_baseline.startup_rule: Read-only D1/R2 verification first. Never reapply the baseline migration merely because a new chat or release starts.
database_baseline.release_448_migrations: allowed_when_required_by_current_448_work_and protected by current migration/tests; do not mutate Production

current_release_migrations.note: Source and transport may move forward while Development D1 execution awaits an authenticated Cloudflare execution surface. Publication enforcement activates only after the lineage schema is present.

deferred_it_test_environment.feature_development_assumption: Continue implementing against Development test/provider abstractions as though required key references are populated. Real credential/provider/media acceptance is completed later from the I.T. test environment.

workstreams.scope: Keep Web, Phone and Desktop as active first-class clients of the same responsive/installable application; preserve explicit opt-in notifications for new releases and newly published items, offline/fallback behavior and no idle polling.

New in-house-created products require real raw-inventory lineage and consumption authority before publication; existing products may remain legacy_pending; antiquity, resale and external finished goods can be explicitly inventory-exempt.
Record durable tools and molds used to create products separately from consumable inventory; tool association never consumes the durable tool.

Link materials/tools to manufacturer/vendor provenance and Devil n Dove-authored purchased-item reviews. Support ASIN/external identifiers and review/profile/source links or owner-supplied import where available; do not make Amazon or another marketplace a runtime dependency and do not copy third-party review content.

Prepare the I.T. test/integration environment for provider/platform reference names, callbacks/webhooks, scopes, environment, configured/tested status, last safe result/error and correction mechanics. Real secret values never belong in D1. Deferred I.T. completion does not gate feature releases.
Generalize Storefront carousel presentation for Movie use without duplicating carousel authority or introducing extra public H1 elements.
Repair provably incorrect Movie names and core metadata; represent unknown/incomplete fields explicitly instead of guessing.
Current and future D1 additions reserve explicit pending, legacy_pending, exempt, unverified, verified and evidence-reference states so unconfirmed workflows never masquerade as proven.

forward_queue: additional top-level modules when ownership boundaries justify them
